story_zh: 工程师小李在工厂里开发一个大型项目。他用尺子测量金属管子的长度，用软件计算数据。他设计了一个自动系统来控制机器生产零件。在车间里，工人用工具组装设备。这个项目需要无数资源，但能提高效率。现代工业需要这样的技术。
story_pinyin: Gōngchéngshī Xiǎo Lǐ zài gōngchǎng lǐ kāifā yīgè dàxíng xiàngmù. Tā yòng chǐzi cèliáng jīnshǔ guǎnzi de chángdù, yòng ruǎnjiàn jìsuàn shùjù. Tā shèjìle yīgè zìdòng xìtǒng lái kòngzhì jīqì shēngchǎn língjiàn. Zài chējiān lǐ, gōngrén yòng gōngjù zǔzhuāng shèbèi. Zhège xiàngmù xūyào wúshù zīyuán, dàn néng tígāo xiàolǜ. Xiàndài gōngyè xūyào zhèyàng de jìshù.
story_en: Engineer Xiao Li is developing a large-scale project in the factory. He uses a ruler to measure the length of metal pipes and software to calculate data. He designed an automatic system to control machines producing parts. In the workshop, workers use tools to assemble equipment. This project requires countless resources but can improve efficiency. Modern industry needs such technology.
